Separately and equally strong: ONE berth with an unrescuable dead holding that the deposit ACCEPTS — that is the door loosened, the thing this ticket is bounded against. THREE consecutive non-vacuous readings with both counts at zero, at least one taken after a voyage that actually retired an address, is WEAK confirmation and also satisfies. A vacuous reading (berths_read == 0) counts toward neither and is itself a red.
